jyrgalan_guide.observed: Summer guided outings: guide supplement KGS 4000; guide-service comparator, not an exact hiking quotation.

food.observed: Picnic lunch KGS 350; lunch/dinner KGS 400. Regional food-budget comparator, not a catering contract.

songkol.observed: 2-day group trek KGS 7000/person: transport, guide, yurt with breakfast, first dinner; trail meals extra.

kolukok_intourists.observed: 2-day group trek KGS 6000/person; transfers, guide, camping; meals extra.

belogorka.observed: Group of 4: USD 59/person, guide and transport; lunch box USD 12 extra.

ratsek_comparator.observed: 2-day Uchitel ascent KGS 5000/person, transfers, park entry, guide and Ratsek overnight/kit; meals extra. More demanding comparator, no ascent added to our itinerary.

alamedin.observed: 4+ people USD 45/person; local day tour with guide, transport and lunch.

jeti_sanity.observed: 2026 detailed table USD 802/person at 4, but includes Bishkek transfers/hotels and only 3 trekking days. Headline USD 200 is inconsistent; neither used as an exact price for five walking days.
